subject: Web Development
title: Speed as a Feature
description: A short lesson to help you apply Speed as a Feature.

hook.text: Chrome's pitch was simple: everything should be fast. Startup, tabs, JavaScript — everything.

buildup.text: Google invested millions in the V8 engine, making JS benchmarks a competitive sport.

discovery.text: Other browsers scrambled to match. Firefox built SpiderMonkey, Safari built Nitro.

twist.text: Chrome's speed obsession raised the bar for all browsers, benefiting every user everywhere.

climax.text: The browser speed wars made the modern web app era possible — from Gmail to Google Docs.

punchline.text: One browser's obsession made all browsers faster.

quiz.question: What JavaScript engine did Chrome introduce?
